title: 5c-5: propose-and-confirm convention lifecycle
description:
## Parent

sutra/57 — 5c PRD: convention system design

## What to build

A propose-and-confirm system for convention lifecycle transitions, plus inverse checking for deprecated/forbidden conventions.

Key pieces:
- Track convention support/confidence history across FCA rebuilds (storage mechanism for historical values)
- Signal detection: stable high support for 3+ snapshots → propose descriptive→preferred; declining support on preferred for 3+ snapshots → propose preferred→deprecated; zero matches for 3+ snapshots on deprecated → propose deletion; new convention contradicting deprecated → surface as replacement candidate
- `convention_proposals` table (durable): convention_id, proposed_transition, signal_rationale, status (pending/accepted/dismissed), timestamps
- Dismissed proposals don't re-trigger unless signal direction reverses
- MCP tool surface for listing conventions with proposals, accepting/dismissing proposals
- Inverse check for deprecated/forbidden: when new or modified code matches a deprecated/forbidden convention, flag advisory warning (the check fires on match, not on non-match)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Convention support/confidence history tracked across rebuilds
- [ ] Proposals auto-generated when signals are detected
- [ ] Proposals stored in durable convention_proposals table
- [ ] Dismissed proposals don't re-trigger for same signal direction
- [ ] MCP tool: list pending proposals, accept, dismiss
- [ ] Deprecated conventions: advisory warning when new/modified code matches the pattern
- [ ] Forbidden conventions: louder advisory when new/modified code matches
- [ ] Tests for signal detection, proposal state machine, inverse checking

## Blocked by

- sutra/58 (module rename)

messages.text:
Codex review (sutra/61+62+64 combined):

Verdict: needs-attention

Findings relevant to 5c-5:
- [high] Dismissed proposals erased by cascade delete (migrations/0017). convention_proposals has ON DELETE CASCADE FK to conventions (ephemeral). Stale convention pruning deletes proposals, so dismissed-do-not-retrigger guard breaks when convention reappears.
- [medium] Deprecated zero-support delete proposals unreachable in pipeline (src/tools/review.rs:326-338). build_findings records history only for present conventions, deletes stale before signal detection. Deprecated convention with zero matches gets no zero-support history row, so ProposeDelete signal can never trigger via the integrated pipeline.
